title: Publish the CI confidence guide on the site and test that each suite has one owner
description: Publish the CI confidence guide on the site and test that each suite has one owner
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-github-006 already requires one authoritative workflow per expensive suite, a trust-lifecycle lane without cargo test, clippy or verify, and lanes.verify as the full local suite; this publishes the guide that explains it and makes the rule an executable test (#493)
acceptance_criteria: the CI confidence guide is a site page under Reference and docs/ci-confidence.md points to it; test-ci-lane-ownership.py passes on the repository and fails when test, lint, verify or a cargo test task is added to trust-lifecycle, when the Trust lifecycle runs another lane, or when verify drops its tests
